# Independent Gompertz controls (development only)

Generated by `examples/mma17p4duration/gompertz_reference.R` with R4.6.1;
source DTA reading additionally uses foreign0.8.91. No production R/Python or
Gompertz-package dependency. Input is the existing400-row synthetic full40-X
`../duration_exponential/input.csv`, **not** original/copyrighted author data.

```
Rscript examples/mma17p4duration/gompertz_reference.R \
  tests/fixtures/duration_exponential/input.csv NEW_DIRECTORY
Rscript examples/mma17p4duration/gompertz_reference.R \
  tests/fixtures/duration_exponential/input.csv NEW_NOCONSTANT_DIRECTORY - noconstant
```

A fixed-gamma Poisson GLM subproblem and scalar profile-score root estimate
beta/gamma; numerical quadrature of exponential time moments independently
supplies the full joint scores/information. `stats::optimHess` finite differences
certify all information blocks (relative1e-6 approximation bound, observed
3.91e-8 or less). Require raw joint score<1e-7, regular Cholesky, inverse identity
error<1e-8. The independent path is not the native joint Newton/closed-form
moment implementation. Robust covariance includes beta/gamma cross terms and
N/(N-1). Natural gamma (not log gamma) is the covariance's final parameter.

`model_based.csv`/`robust.csv`:2030/2029 scalar gates, including all1764 joint
covariance entries; no-intercept counterparts1941/1940, all1681 entries.
Normal95, gamma0 z, same-sample gamma-refitted null, selected slope Wald;
robust LR p is deliberately absent. Positive inference tails use relative gates,
not a large absolute tolerance. Standard native comparisons:1e-9 absolute+1e-8
relative; positive p tails1e-300+1e-8 relative. These do not authorize tolerance
changes for unexplained disagreements.

`predictions.csv` preserves the44 raw control columns then12 numerical-integral
reference points: current observed/UI0/UI1 xb/hazard/cumulative_hazard/net_survival
at the SAME times, with both UI interactions changed together. No causal or
proper-infinite-tail claim. `moments.csv` independently integrates log exprel,
E[u],E[u²] for z=gamma*time across zero, both signs and ±1000; these are
quadrature controls, not copied native formulas. `parameter_names.txt` gives
full matrix order. Values use17 significant digits; no original-source data,
predictions or hex cells are redistributed.

## Small regular negative-gamma control

Kernel tests additionally use time1:4, events1/0/0/0, intercept only. Reproduce
independently with direct time integrals and an analytic conditional intercept:

```r
t<-1:4;d<-c(1,0,0,0)
a<-function(g,j)vapply(t,function(t)integrate(function(s)s^j*exp(g*s),
  0,t,rel.tol=1e-13)$value,numeric(1))
score<-function(g)sum(d*t)-sum(d)/sum(a(g,0))*sum(a(g,1))
g<-uniroot(score,c(-10,0),tol=1e-13)$root
rate<-sum(d)/sum(a(g,0))
I<-rate*matrix(c(sum(a(g,0)),sum(a(g,1)),sum(a(g,1)),sum(a(g,2))),2)
B<-solve(I);U<-cbind(d-rate*a(g,0),d*t-rate*a(g,1))
V<-B%*%crossprod(U)%*%B*4/3
options(digits=17)
print(c(intercept=log(rate),gamma=g,
  log_likelihood=sum(d)*log(rate)+g*sum(d*t)-rate*sum(a(g,0))))
print(B);print(V)
```

Gamma−.55943052800207316, intercept−1.61345797507466737, density
LL−3.17288850307674064; both FULL2x2 model/robust covariance matrices are gated
in the kernel test. This is not the original chapter sample. A separate exact
exponential control uses events1/1/0/0: rate1/5, gamma0,
I=[[2,3],[3,20/3]], inverse=[[20/13,−9/13],[−9/13,6/13]]. Estimating gamma
makes beta variance20/13, not the conditional fixed-shape Poisson1/2.
